title: Forgax
type: Thri-kreen researcher and armored spellcaster · First Called
dek: A proud researcher who enters danger to learn what others cannot see, then survives long enough underground to return with warnings, samples and unfinished notes.

facts.Early company: First Called · Day 1 of the Final War
facts.Method: Armored spellcraft, observation and recorded research
facts.Companions: Scribonia · Jako · Jiangshi · the company that finds him in The Before
facts.Return: Leaves The Before alive in the Month of Aionia, Year 2; exact confinement history remains partial

body:
Forgax arrives studying his surroundings and marking notes on his armor. His pride is immediately visible in the insult he directs toward Scribonia, another thri-kreen. Curiosity and a strong insistence on his own agency shape the help he is willing to give.

Aid offered, not obedience owed

Forgax asks whether Death threatens only Fenumion or his own world as well. He prepares his quarterstaff and arcane gauntlet when danger approaches, but objects to being ordered about: he offers his aid freely. He refuses to let caution become an excuse for learning nothing.

The rivalry with Scribonia does not prevent cooperation. Forgax watches how shadows affect their enemies and notices that not every shadow serves Death. The habit is already to separate what he observes from a broad explanation that might be too simple.

Following a vision others cannot share

With the talisman sword, Forgax sees black smoke, ash and an ominous pillar where companions see a different landscape. He thanks the people willing to trust him, tells them what he can see and warns that he does not know what danger waits at the source.

Closer to it, he grows cold and frightened. He tests his gauntlets against the ground because the weave seems absent to him. Jako’s touch reassures him, and he accepts a rope before entering. His choice is deliberate: knowledge that could help the company seems worth the risk, though he asks them to retrieve him if he falls.

The researcher can be afraid

Inside the darkness, his notes become shaky fragments rather than a clean account. He tries to hold on to Jiangshi’s melody and reports something colossal associated with the Wyrm. When he returns toward Quake, Jako helps keep him from falling.

His later explanation is an interpretation of what the sword revealed: a footprint and a vast leg where the creature had been. The experience frightens him and the darkness feels capable of reaching inside. The Codex preserves that reported perception without turning every part of a vision into an ordinary survey of a present creature.

The sky after The Before

The later company finds Forgax underground, where he recognizes signs that hostile manifestations are gathering. He identifies himself as a thri-kreen when called a bug, warns the strangers, shields himself and fights with the gauntlets that have helped keep him alive.

When escape becomes possible, he gathers a small collection of notes and a sample before running. Outside he exclaims at the sky, thanks the people who sought him and helps heal Cecil. His first response after safety is again to review what he learned. The return is witnessed; the entire history of his confinement is not supplied by it.

A changed world outside

Fighting beside adventurers again, Forgax admits that he has missed much of the past year. He is sorry for the corruption others suffered to retrieve him and asks whether it can be cleansed. He identifies himself to the company as someone brought out of The Before after a long imprisonment.

News about Scribonia unsettles him. If his old rival is truly lost, he says, Pristinia has lost a good wizard. That conditional response records what he is being told at the time; it does not establish Scribonia’s final fate. Forgax returns to town with both his pride and an ability to recognize another scholar’s value.
